rules.name: Big Brother
rules.description:
Universal Rule.
The model’s Health Points are set to 8, and its base size is changed to 75×100 mm. The roll for the number of hits from its Stomp Attacks is subject to Maximised Roll.

selectionEntryGroups.name: Essence of a Free Mind Magic Path

rules.name: Archery Drills
rules.description:
Archery Drills: Attack Attribute – Shooting.
The model can shoot from third and fourth rank if it did not move during this Player Turn and if its unit has at least one Full Rank.

rules.name: Knights of the Court
rules.description:
Universal Rule.
The model gains Bodyguard (Sainted or General with Courage).
In addition, unless Charging out of the unit, Characters joined to units with one or more models with Knights of the Court gain Devastating Charge (+1′′ Adv).

rules.name: Wizard Conclave
rules.description:
Must select 2 spells from:
• Deceptive Glamour (Witchcraft)
• Healing Waters (Druidism)
• Savage Fury (Shamanism)
• Scrying (Divination)

rules.name: Quin
rules.description:
Counts as two Heroic Traits.
The model is a Wizard Adept that chooses Witchcraft as its Path of Magic. If on foot, the model gains Scout.

rules.name: Cleric
rules.description: The model gains Honesty, Ordo Minister, Ordained and loses Ordeal.

rules.name: Bannerman
rules.description: The model becomes the Battle Standard Bearer.

rules.name: Ministrel
rules.description: The model gains Musician and is a Wizard Apprentice that chooses Divination as its Path of Magic.

rules.name: Castellan
rules.description: The model part gains +2 Attack Value.
